project_type: pnpm monorepo: NestJS 10 + Prisma API (apps/api), Next.js 14 app-router storefront+admin (apps/web, client components), shared TS library (packages/shared)
build_system: pnpm workspaces. QUIRK: API `tsc` (typecheck/lint/build) resolves @belzo/shared through packages/shared/package.json -> dist/ (apps/api/tsconfig.json sets paths: {}), so after ANY change in packages/shared you MUST run `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build` before API typecheck/lint. API + web Jest and web tsc/next map @belzo/shared to packages/shared/src directly (next.config.mjs transpilePackages).
test_framework: jest + ts-jest everywhere. packages/shared: src/**/*.test.ts (fast-check available). apps/api: src/**/*.spec.ts (hand-rolled prisma stubs cast `as unknown as PrismaService`). apps/web: src/**/*.test.ts, testEnvironment node -> only PURE helpers in src/lib are testable (no React rendering).
test_command: pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test; pnpm --filter @belzo/api test; pnpm --filter @belzo/web test
verification_instructions: From c:\xampp\htdocs\Belzo, in order: 1) pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test  2) pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build  3) pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @belzo/api lint && pnpm --filter @belzo/api test  4) pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @belzo/web test && pnpm --filter @belzo/web build (next build also runs next lint). All must pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/shared/dist is gitignored build output (rebuild, never commit). No Prisma schema change is planned -> no migration / prisma generate needed. apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo may change on typecheck: do not commit it unless already tracked-and-modified by the build (check `git status`).
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Work directly on branch master in c:\xampp\htdocs\Belzo (NO worktree). Never deploy (do not run `pnpm deploy*` or scripts/deploy.ps1). Never push. Do not start/kill dev servers. Commit locally with clear conventional messages, staging specific files only (repo has many untracked .agents/ files and secrets like .env, Belzo-key.pem - never stage those).
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits (feat/fix/test/...). Keep ownership checks (customerId === user.sub) on every customer endpoint. Do not change money math, pricing engine, invoices or the order state machine (ORDER_TRANSITIONS / canCustomerCancel). No new dependencies. Pin nothing new. Accessible UI (labels, fieldset/legend, role=dialog, focus management, aria-live).
key_patterns: API: zod DTOs via createZodDto (apps/api/src/modules/identity/zod-dto) in controllers; services throw NotFound/Forbidden/BadRequestException; storage port STORAGE_PROVIDER (global StorageModule) with getUrl(key) -> public URL (local: `${CDN_BASE_URL||PUBLIC_BASE_URL||''}/api/uploads/<key>` - may be RELATIVE; s3: `${cdn}/<key>` or s3 URL); customer image upload pattern in apps/api/src/modules/media/review-media.controller.ts (FileInterceptor 'file', 15 MB, /^image\/(jpeg|png|webp|gif|avif)$/, key `<folder>/<randomUUID>.<ext>`). Shipping port apps/api/src/integrations/shipping/shipping.provider.ts. Shared state machine packages/shared/src/constants.ts (ORDER_STATUSES, ORDER_TRANSITIONS) + orders.ts (canTransition, canCustomerCancel). Web: client pages use useAuth().authFetch<T>(path,{method,body}) (apps/web/src/lib/auth-context.tsx), errors are ApiClientError with .message; money via formatInr (apps/web/src/lib/catalogue-api.ts, integer paise); price rows via breakupView (apps/web/src/lib/price-breakup.ts) which handles GST-inclusive vs legacy-exclusive orders and always sums to grandTotal; variant attrs via pickAttr(attrs,'size') / pickAttr(attrs,'colour','color') in apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.ts; images via isUsableImageUrl/placeholderImage (apps/web/src/lib/category-theme.ts); customer upload via apps/web/src/lib/customer-upload.ts (compressImage first); modals follow .pingate / .pm-modal (fixed overlay, role=dialog aria-modal). Styles are global classes in apps/web/src/app/globals.css (vars --fk-blue, --fk-navy, --fk-orange, --fk-green, --ink, --muted-2 (use for small text, AA contrast), --border, --border-2, --surface-2, --radius, --shadow-sm; .btn (orange primary), .btn--blue; order list uses .ord, .ord-row*, .ord-badge + --ok/--info/--warn/--bad).
directory_structure: packages/shared/src: pure domain helpers + tests, re-exported from index.ts. apps/api/src/modules/<domain>: controllers/services/specs (orders, media, checkout, catalogue...). apps/api/src/integrations: ports+adapters (shipping, storage, payments). apps/web/src/app/(shop): storefront routes (orders list + orders/[id] detail); apps/web/src/lib: client helpers + jest tests; apps/web/src/app/globals.css: all storefront CSS.
root_cause_stale_status: Shipment.status is written once as 'packed' in FulfilmentService.createShipment and NEVER updated by syncTracking. MockShippingProvider.getTracking returns a fixed canned [packed, shipped, out_for_delivery] list (times relative to now) regardless of the order; syncTracking (run once by OrdersWorker on order.confirmed) stores those events (and duplicates them on every re-sync) and tries a single-step transition packed->out_for_delivery which is illegal, so nothing moves. The admin then PATCHes the order to delivered, so order.status=delivered while shipment.status=packed and events stop at out_for_delivery. Fix = read-time reconciliation (shared reconcileTracking) + mock timeline driven by order status + syncTracking that dedupes, updates shipment.status and walks legal transitions.
